content:
The most recent UEFA Champions League final was held on **June 10, 2023**, at the Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul, Turkey. **Manchester City** won their first Champions League title by defeating **Internazionale Milano (Inter Milan)** **1-0**. The only goal of the match was scored by **Rodri** in the 68th minute. This victory secured Manchester City's historic treble (Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League) in the 2022-23 season. 

If you're checking this in or after 2024, the 2023-24 final will take place in London on June 1, 2024, so updates will follow after that date.
